verses.gurmukhi: ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਾਪਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਦਾ ਗਲਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: ganikaa paapan hoi kai paapaa(n) dhaa gal haar parotaa|

en.bdb: Gankaa was a sinful prostitute who wore the necklace of misdeeds around her neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਚਾਣਚਕ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਵਾੜੇ ਆਇ ਖਲੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: mahaa(n) purakh aachaanachak ganikaa vaaRe aai khalotaa|

en.bdb: Once a great man was passing by who halted in her courtyard.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਥਹੁ ਉਸ ਨੋ ਦਿਤੋਨੁ ਤੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuramat dhekh dhiaal hoi hathahu us no dhiton totaa|

en.bdb: Seeing her bad plight he became compassionate and offered her a special parrot.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਖੇਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਦੇ ਵਣਜੁ ਸਓਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: raam naam upadhes kar khel giaa dhe vanaj sotaa|

en.bdb: He told her to teach the parrot to repeat the name of Ram. Having made her understand this fruitful trade he then went away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਿਵ ਲਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੋਤਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਏ ਕਰੈ ਅਸੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: liv lagee tis totiahu nit paRhaae karai asotaa|

en.bdb: Each and every day, with full concentration, she would teach the parrot to say Ram.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤੁ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਲੇਵਰੁ ਧੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran raam naam dhuramat paap kalevar dhotaa|

en.bdb: The name of Lord is the liberator of the fallen ones. It washed away her evil wisdom and deeds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ਤੋੜਿ ਨਰਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਧੁ ਸੁ ਗੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal jam jaal toR narakai vich na khaadhu su gotaa|

en.bdb: At the time of death, it cut away the noose of Yama - the messenger of death she did not have to drown in the ocean of hell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਈ ਬੈਕੁੰਠਿ ਬਿਬਾਣਿ ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਨਾਉਂ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ ਛੋਤਿ ਅਛੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: giee baiku(n)Th bibaan chaReh naau(n) rasain chhot achhotaa|

en.bdb: Due to the elixir of name (of the Lord) she became totally devoid of sins and was lifted to the heavens.
The name (of the Lord) is the last refuge of the shelterless ones.
